description: Envelope generator on very long time scales: a delay, then attack, decay, sustain and release, with every stage set in seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months.

params.text: Makes the delay number count in that unit, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months; the lit one is the unit in use.
Sets how many time units pass at zero before the attack starts, 0 to 100.
Makes the attack number count in that unit, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months; the lit one is the unit in use.
Sets how many time units the rise from zero to full takes, 0 to 100.
Makes the rise a straight line from zero to full.
Makes the rise start slowly and steepen towards full.
Makes the rise start quickly and level off towards full.
Makes the decay number count in that unit, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months; the lit one is the unit in use.
Sets how many time units the fall from full to the sustain level takes, 0 to 100.
Makes the fall to the sustain level a straight line.
Makes the fall to the sustain level start slowly and steepen at the end.
Makes the fall to the sustain level start quickly and level off at the end.
Sets the level the envelope rests at after the decay, from zero to full.
Makes the release number count in that unit, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months; the lit one is the unit in use.
Sets how many time units the fall from the sustain level back to zero takes, 0 to 100.
Makes the fall back to zero a straight line.
Makes the fall back to zero start slowly and steepen at the end.
Makes the fall back to zero start quickly and level off at the end.
Makes the hold number count in that unit, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months; the lit one is the unit in use.
Sets how many time units pass between the start of the envelope and the release, 0 to 100, for when the release is not ended by a gate going low.
Starts the envelope.
Chooses what ends the sustain: the trigger voltage falling, or the hold time running out.
Chooses whether the envelope starts again as soon as the release ends or stops there; starting again works only in the TRIG position of the gate switch.
Chooses what a trigger part way through does: start the whole envelope again from the delay, or go straight to the attack from the level already reached.

inputs.text: A trigger here starts the envelope; in the GATE position the envelope is held until the voltage here falls.
Voltage added to the delay number, 1V for 10.
Voltage added to the attack number, 1V for 10.
Voltage added to the decay number, 1V for 10.
Voltage added to the sustain level, 10V for full.
Voltage added to the hold number, 1V for 10.

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 1ms long each time the release finishes.

notes: the envelope rests at zero until the trigger button is pressed or a trigger arrives at the trigger input.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
